semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in automated material handling systems for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shanghai Fortrend Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the R&D, production, and sales of automated material handling systems specifically designed for semiconductor applications. With over 45 years of experience, the company offers comprehensive solutions for handling semiconductor wafers, photomasks, and substrates.
capabilities: Automated material handling systems for semiconductor wafers
Front-end sorting and handling automation systems (SORTER/EFEM)

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Minhang District, Shanghai, and operates multiple subsidiaries across the country.
